component.name: PaintNotNet
component.summary: A lightweight, powerful, and modern image editor for Linux inspired by Paint.NET

description.p: PaintNotNet is an image editing application built with Python 3 and PyQt6. Designed to deliver a smooth, fast, and familiar workflow for users seeking an intuitive alternative to tools like Paint.NET on Linux and Windows.

ul.li: Live language switching between English and Spanish.
Comprehensive drawing, selection, and shape tools.
Advanced color picker and adjustments like Exposure, Levels, Sepia.
Native .pnn project format to save layers, transparencies, and history.
